notes: Evaluates /cadence-close consolidated close-out workflow: read_state.py preflight, tier-conditional Gate 3 (/cadence-maintain on Medium/High vs skip on Low), /cadence-merge --no-archive + tracker sync, and /cadence-archive handoff.

evals.name: medium-tier-requires-gate3-before-merge-on-fixture
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-close ACME-112 when Gate 2 code review passed with blocking=0 but maintainer_approved_at is still empty.
evals.expected_output: Reads ACME-112 state via read_state.py, sees tier=Medium, status=in-review, ledger_last blocking=0, and maintainer_approved_at unset; runs /cadence-maintain before /cadence-merge --no-archive and /cadence-archive.
assertions: Reads metadata state via read_state.py rather than manual YAML parsing
Enforces Gate 3 /cadence-maintain when tier is Medium/High and maintainer_approved_at is empty
Chains /cadence-merge --no-archive and /cadence-archive unless deferred or cancelled

evals.name: low-tier-skips-gate3-and-honors-no-archive
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-close ACME-109 --no-archive after Gate 2 approval at Low tier.
evals.expected_output: Logs gate3=SKIPPED (tier exempt), merges via /cadence-merge --no-archive resolving #branch-strategy-binding, stops cleanly when --no-archive is passed, and verifies post-close doctor health.
assertions: Skips /cadence-maintain at Low and Trivial tiers without failing on empty maintainer_approved_at
Honors --no-archive flag cleanly and resolves integration branch dynamically
